changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to canonical forms (removed version details), removed duplicate ChatGPT reference, added RoBERTa-base which was mentioned as base model, and improved output description clarity
Normalized F1 variants to base form 'F1' since multiple F1 variants were used but represent the same metric family
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators - only as generation models. All extracted metadata was removed.

guideline: Human annotators evaluated counterfactuals on commonsense alignment using 3-point scale: aligned (2), marginally aligned (1), and not aligned (0)

changes_made.explanation: Removed the scoring categories (aligned/marginally/not aligned) as they are implementations of the criteria, not the criteria themselves. Added missing criteria mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating counterfactual examples for relation extraction, which qualifies as an NLG task. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization (model names, metric variants) and minor additions of missing criteria for human evaluation.
